outcome: poor hemostasis (defined as hemorrhage volume ≥200 mL)
postoperative complications (abdominal pain, low fever, nausea and vomiting, and buttock pain)
cohort: 841 patients with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) who underwent prophylactic UAE and curettage
finding: Prophylactic UAE before curettage in patients with CSP is safe and effective in reducing intraoperative hemorrhage.
